name: @agentic-skills/seo-workbench
description: Local SEO audits, saved page evidence and verification of fixes

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node --check web/app.js && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2023 --module NodeNext --skipLibCheck --strict --allowImportingTsExtensions examples/trusted-rule.ts examples/trusted-extractor.ts examples/trusted-provider.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests web examples data *.json *.md docs
